symptom: `alter page … { set (MaxFileSize: 20) on fileManager1; }` was refused with `property "MaxFileSize" is not a property of this built-in widget` (likewise Type, AllowedExtensions, ShowFileInBrowser), although `create page` accepted all four on a filemanager (mendixlabs/mxcli#151).
cause: setRawWidgetPropertyMut dispatches first-class keys by name and sends everything else to the pluggable setter, which refuses on a native widget. Adding a widget keyword to create (builder + writer + describe) does not reach the ALTER path, which is a separate dispatch over raw BSON.
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go (setWidgetFileManagerMut; the case is gated on pages.IsFileManager so `Type` on a pluggable widget keeps its route); sdk/pages/pages_widgets_input.go (CanonicalFileManagerType, shared with buildFileManagerV3)
insight: When a widget gains CREATE support, ALTER SET is the second write path to wire: probe it with one `set` per new property before calling the feature done. Gate a generic key like `Type` on the stored $Type rather than claiming it for every widget, and validate with the builder's own rule so set cannot store what create refuses. Keep a stored int's width (int32 vs int64), as DecimalPrecision does.
